unit.why: A single narrative: a rich leaseholder whose fields were taken by a gentile is sent by R. Simcha Bunem of Peshischa to the Saba Kadisha of Strikov, whose curse restores the lease.

stories.start_quote: ע״ש מעשה מהק׳ הנ״ל שהיה בא
stories.summary_en: A rich man loses his leased fields to a gentile. R. Simcha Bunem sends him to the Saba Kadisha of Strikov with the claim that he leases them to feed the poor. The Saba's curse forces the gentile to return the fields, and R. Bunem then explains that he knew the claim was untrue and could not help the man himself.

tags.why: The tsaddik advises a man on his land lease.
